
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/hadluo/p/19142333" title="发布于 2025-10-14 23:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">PaddleOCR源码安装+centos7.6+python3.10</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 14px">先自行安装python3，版本如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<p>[root@localhost IOPaint]# python3 --version Python 3.10.6</p>
</div>
<p>安装gcc9</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div># 安装 SCL 仓库</div>
<div>sudo yum install -y centos-release-scl</div>
</div>
</div>
<div># 安装 devtoolset-9（包含 GCC 9）</div>
<div>sudo yum install -y devtoolset-9-toolchain</div>
<div>
<div># 安装完整的开发工具集</div>
</div>
<div>
<div>sudo yum install -y devtoolset-9-gcc devtoolset-9-gcc-c++ devtoolset-9-binutils</div>
<div>
<div>
<div>echo 'source /opt/rh/devtoolset-9/enable' &gt;&gt; ~/.bashrc</div>
<div>source ~/.bashrc</div>
<div># 查看版本，9的版本就是对的</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>gcc --version</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>基础环境</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 安装必要的依赖包
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">sudo yum install </span>-y openssl-devel bzip2-devel libffi-devel zlib-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">devel
sudo yum install </span>-y sqlite-devel readline-devel tk-devel gdbm-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">devel
sudo yum install </span>-y xz-devel expat-devel ncurses-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">devel

# 安装图像处理相关依赖
sudo yum install </span>-y libjpeg-devel libpng-devel libtiff-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">devel
sudo yum install </span>-y freetype-devel lcms2-devel libwebp-devel</pre>
</div>
<p>下载源码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>mkdir /opt/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">PaddleOCR
cd </span>/opt/PaddleOCR</pre>
<div>&nbsp; git clone https://gitee.com/paddlepaddle/PaddleOCR.git</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp; cd PaddleOCR</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp; # 切换到 3.2.0 版本</div>
<div>&nbsp; git checkout v3.2.0</div>
<div>
<pre><em><span class="token function"><span class="token builtin class-name"><span class="token comment"># 创建虚拟环境
<span class="token parameter variable">python3 -m venv paddle-ocr-env

<span class="token comment"># 激活虚拟环境
<span class="token builtin class-name">source </span></span></span></span></span></span></em>paddle-ocr-env<span class="token function">/bin/activate</span></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>如需退出虚拟环境，请执行：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>deactivate</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>安装 PaddlePaddle 框架</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<div>python3 -m pip install paddlepaddle==3.1.1 -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple</div>
</div>
<p>安装源码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<div># 安装基础依赖</div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<p><em id="__mceDel">pip3 install -r requirements.txt -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple</em></p>
<p># 如果需要使用 PP-StructureV3 文档解析功能<br>python3 -m pip install "paddleocr[doc_analysis]"&nbsp;<em id="__mceDel">-i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple</em></p>
<p># 如果需要使用 PP-ChatOCRv4 信息抽取功能<br>python3 -m pip install "paddleocr[kie]"&nbsp;<em id="__mceDel">-i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple</em></p>
<p># 源码安装</p>
</div>
<div>python3 -m pip install -e . -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>报错</div>
<div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># 安装 devtoolset-9</pre>
<pre>sudo yum install -y devtoolset-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>-toolchain devtoolset-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>-libstdc++-devel<br><br># 检查 libstdc++ 文件位置</pre>
<pre>find /opt/rh/devtoolset-9/ -name "libstdc++.so*" 2&gt;/dev/null<br><br></pre>
<div>
<div>&nbsp; # 启用 devtoolset-9 工具集</div>
<div>&nbsp; source /opt/rh/devtoolset-9/enable</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp; 验证 gcc 版本（应该显示 9.x.x）</div>
<div>&nbsp; gcc --version</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>&nbsp; # 查找 devtoolset-9 中所有的 libstdc++ 文件</div>
<div>&nbsp; find /opt/rh/devtoolset-9/ -name "*libstdc++*" -type f 2&gt;/dev/null</div>
<br>
<div>&nbsp; # 如果在 gcc 目录中找到，复制到系统目录</div>
<div>&nbsp; if [ -f "/opt/rh/devtoolset-9/root/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redhat-linux/9/libstdc++.so" ]; then</div>
<div>&nbsp; &nbsp; sudo ln -sf /opt/rh/devtoolset-9/root/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redhat-linux/9/libstdc++.so /lib64/libstdc++.so.6</div>
<div>&nbsp; fi</div>

</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
